requirements: Is there exactly one grid of 4 columns by 4 rows showing 16 distinct items?
Are the 16 items arranged left to right and top to bottom in the exact order listed in the prompt?
Does each item sit centered in its own cell with at least 12 percent empty margin on every side?
Do no items touch or cross any cell edges or overlap with any other item?
Is the first item an oat milk latte in a cup with a heart in the foam?
Is the second item a gold medal on a ribbon showing a cracked-ground icon?
Is the fourth item a round traffic light glowing bright green with a black rim and short cable?
Is the eighth item a wrapped birthday present in purple paper with a gold ribbon and bow?
Is the fourteenth item a white shirt with puffy fuzzy cuffs shown laid flat?
Is the sixteenth item a gold sparkly birthday sash with a big gold bow shown draped?
